ambiguities.description: Composite uniqueness on Employee assigned to Project: The constraint states 'An employee is either on a project or not; there is no double assignment.' This prevents duplicate assignments of the same employee to the same project. The model captures this as a composite uniqueness on [Employee, Project]. However, the transcript does not explicitly state whether multiple employees can work on the same project (which the model assumes) or whether one employee can be assigned to multiple projects (which the model allows, constrained by frequency). Clarification: Is the uniqueness constraint {Employee, Project} (an employee can work on only one instance of a project), or is it something else?

source_references.excerpt: can an employee be put on the same project twice? No. An employee is either on a project or not; there is no double assignment.

ambiguities.description: Role direction in Employee mentors Employee fact type: The fact type 'Employee mentors Employee' is a self-referencing binary with two Employee roles. The model assigns role names 'mentors' (first role) and 'is mentored by' (second role). The transcript states 'each employee has at most one mentor' and 'a mentor can have many mentees'. The constraint labeled 'Each employee has at most one mentor' is applied to the first role (mentors), but logically an employee HAS a mentor by BEING mentored (the second role). Clarification: Should the uniqueness constraint on mentorship be on the second role (the mentee side who is limited to one mentor) rather than the first role (the mentor side)?

ambiguities.description: Mandatory participation in Employee assigned to Project: The transcript states 'Every employee is assigned to at least one project' (line 3), which establishes a minimum frequency of 1. This is modeled as a frequency constraint with min=1. However, the reverse direction is not addressed: must every project have at least one employee assigned to it, or can a project exist with no assigned employees? Clarification: Is assignment of employees to projects mandatory from the project side (every project must have at least one employee)?
